say:1:1534428001:1.text: Y-you clapped for me! Even though I sounded awful, you were still kind. Thank you.
say:1:1534428001:1.source_cn: 你、你给我鼓掌了！我唱的不好听，你也愿意给我鼓励……你...
say:1:1534428001:1.male: Y-you clapped for me! Even though I sounded awful, you were still kind. Thank you.
say:1:1534428001:1.female: Y-you clapped for me! Even though I sounded awful, you were still kind. Thank you.

say:2:1534428002:1.text: I'm going to keep practicing! Someday, I'll be the greatest singer in the whole Wildborn tribe!
say:2:1534428002:1.source_cn: 我会继续努力的！总有一天，我要成为雅库伯尔唱歌最好听的人！
